# SakuraNFT

> Winter sakura-themed NFT marketplace and DEX on the LitVM (LiteForge) network. Mint, trade NFTs, and swap zkLTC tokens.

SakuraNFT combines an NFT marketplace, a token DEX with liquidity pools, and social features (likes, comments, watchlists, leaderboards) on the LitVM testnet.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured drops, trending NFTs, and platform overview.
- [Marketplace](/marketplace): Browse, search, and buy listed NFTs.
- [Mint](/mint): Create and mint new NFTs with optional AI-assisted artwork and descriptions.
- [DEX](/dex): Swap zkLTC and supported tokens.
- [Liquidity](/dex/liquidity): Add or remove liquidity from token pools.
- [Analytics](/analytics): Platform metrics and volume charts.
- [Leaderboard](/leaderboard): Top traders and collectors.

## Optional

- [Watchlist](/watchlist): Saved NFTs (per-user).
- [Profile](/profile): Connected wallet profile (per-user).
